pro_course_detail.title: Speak with Confidence – Practical English for Everyday Conversations
pro_course_detail.description:
By the end of this lesson, you will:
✅ Improve fluency and confidence in speaking English.
✅ Learn useful expressions for everyday conversations.
✅ Enhance pronunciation and natural intonation.

Who This Lesson Is For:

This lesson is designed for intermediate English learners (B1-B2) who want to improve their ability to speak naturally and comfortably in daily conversations.

Lesson Structure:

1️⃣ Warm-up & Introduction (5 min)

    - Quick conversation on a familiar topic (e.g., weekend plans, favorite activities).
    - Icebreaker questions to get comfortable.

2️⃣ Key Vocabulary & Expressions (10 min)

    - Learn common phrases for small talk and social interactions.
    - Practice using them in short dialogues.

3️⃣ Speaking Practice – Role Play & Discussion (15 min)

    - Real-life scenarios: Ordering food, making small talk, asking for directions, etc.
    - Interactive role-plays where you practice speaking in a natural setting.

4️⃣ Pronunciation & Fluency Tips (5 min)

    - Focus on rhythm, stress, and intonation for natural speech.
    - Correction of common mistakes with clear explanations.

5️⃣ Wrap-up & Feedback (5 min)

    - Review key takeaways.
    - Personalized feedback with areas to improve.
    - Homework suggestion (e.g., practice journaling, record a voice note).

Why Take This Lesson?

⭐ Interactive & engaging – No boring grammar drills!
⭐ Learn real-life English – Speak like a native.
⭐ Personalized corrections & feedback to improve faster.

📅 Book this lesson today and start speaking English with confidence!
